facts.fact: 两周两次偏头痛，第一次发生在亲子课上
facts.anchor: that’s two migraines in a fortnight, the first being during the parent-child cookery class

facts.fact: Mel 的车其实是她签给未婚夫 EJ 的——他先劝她把积蓄花在车上；Flora 看出不妥却选择沉默
facts.anchor: she signed it over to him after he encouraged her to use her savings on it

facts.fact: 施工队承诺十二月初完工——她信用卡刷爆，评估费还差大半
facts.anchor: I’ve maxed out all my credit cards, and I still haven’t got a sixth of what I need

facts.fact: 约会创伤：被骂 robot 和太情绪化——露一点真我就被退货
facts.anchor: One guy called me a robot because I felt nothing when he told me about his dead grandma

facts.fact: 她向 Mel 承认：那个男人逗她就能点燃她，甚至没碰到她
facts.anchor: He turned me on just by cheeking me. He didn’t even touch me.

facts.fact: Jem 生疑：陌生美国人来电找她——他抄号码「抄错」只剩九位
facts.anchor: I only wrote down nine numbers, I must’ve missed two.

facts.fact: Liz 说 Storm Chasers 今晚有比赛还有余票，球员赛后留场见球迷
facts.anchor: The players usually stay behind to chat with fans after. You could speak then.

facts.fact: 章末：她什么都没做错，却不知道怎么修复这段友谊
facts.anchor: I don’t know how to repair this friendship when I didn’t do anything wrong.
